author: BALCETUL
quote: **13 years of development, and this is what we get? Seriously, Rockstar?**I expected GTA 6 to represent a truly modern approach to gaming. After 13 years of development, I expected an incredible level of realism, freedom, immersion, and attention to **** what the hell is this?Invisible walls everywhere. In certain clubs and scripted scenes, your character suddenly becomes incapable of doing basic things. You can't walk through certain areas, pull out a weapon, shoot, or even throw a punch. You're playing as the main character, yet it feels like you're some kind of trained pet on a **** walk into a bar, and suddenly your freedom disappears. No weapons, no fighting, no interaction. You're just forced to follow invisible restrictions like some obedient **** this supposed to be an open-world game? Where is the freedom? Where is the realism? Where is the attention to detail Rockstar kept us waiting for all these years?And on top of all that, we're stuck with a miserable 30 FPS on consoles. Seriously? In 2026, after 13 years of development, this is what we're supposed to accept? I don't give a damn about consoles. I love gaming on PC, where I expect proper performance, high frame rates, and the freedom to customize my experience. I'm not interested in being held back by outdated console hardware and its limitations. Why should PC players have to put up with this kind of nonsense?I wasn't expecting GTA 6 to be perfect, but after 13 years of development, I certainly expected something more ambitious than invisible walls, ridiculous scripted restrictions, and outdated technical limitations.Honestly, I'm incredibly disappointed. I never expected Rockstar to deliver something that would make the player feel so restricted in a game that is supposed to be about **** as for professional critics and their reviews: don't blindly trust them or waste your time listening to their sugar-coated nonsense. Make up your own mind and judge the game by actually playing it. Too many reviews feel like meaningless corporate PR rather than honest criticism. **Stop treating critic scores as gospel.****13 years, Rockstar. Thirteen **** years. And this is what you came up with?**
